generation_mode.Next clip: Generate the next eligible unapproved clip while reusing available approved results.
generation_mode.All clips: Process the eligible sequence, retaining reusable approved results.
generation_mode.Conditioning only: Prepare model guidance for advanced use; do not expect a new rendered video.

canvas_policy.manual: Use this stage's explicit width and height.
canvas_policy.original: Follow source dimensions when available, with supported alignment.
canvas_policy.auto: Use the Director megapixel budget and aspect policy.
canvas_policy.follow: Refine follows the actual first-pass aspect with its megapixel budget.

decoded_output.full: Return a full assembled raw frame/audio batch. Uses more output storage/retention.
decoded_output.latest: Return only the last output clip as raw frames/audio; keep all current cache results for preview/export.

split_mode.highres_steps: Reserve the specified final step count for target-resolution SelfLift sampling.
split_mode.transition_step: Choose the explicit low-to-high-resolution transition point instead.

sampler_mode.euler: Use SelfLift's supported Euler state path.
sampler_mode.follow_director: Follow the Director sampler only if compatible with SelfLift's checked state handling.

latent_upsample.bilinear: Smooth spatial interpolation between latent values.
latent_upsample.nearest: Copy nearest latent values, preserving sharper block boundaries.

mode.refine: Run extra diffusion at the existing resolution; target size is ignored.
mode.upscale: Enlarge once, then run the configured diffusion refinement passes.
mode.latent_upscale: Perform enlargement/preparation without additional diffusion sampling.

upscale_precision.auto: Let the supported upscale path choose precision.
upscale_precision.bf16: Use bfloat16 where supported; lower memory than fp32 with a different numerical range/precision tradeoff.
upscale_precision.fp16: Use float16 where supported; lower memory than fp32, with reduced numerical range.
upscale_precision.fp32: Use float32 where supported; higher memory and numerical precision.

upscale_method.latent: Resize compressed H3 video data, using the selected latent preparation model/interpolation.
upscale_method.learned_pixel: Decode, process with a connected image upscale model, and re-encode for refinement.
upscale_method.RTX VSR: Use the supported NVIDIA RTX video-super-resolution path; SDK/runtime required.
upscale_method.bicubic: Ordinary smooth pixel resampling, not learned detail generation.
upscale_method.lanczos: Windowed-sinc pixel resampling; compare edges for ringing.

seed_policy.legacy: Use clip seed plus zero-based refinement pass index.
seed_policy.inherit: Use the clip seed unchanged for every pass.
seed_policy.offset: Start at clip seed + 1 and increment per pass.
seed_policy.independent: Use the separate refine_seed, incremented by pass index.

resize_method.Stretch: Fill the target by changing proportions.
resize_method.Center Crop (Fill): Fill the target without stretching by cropping edges.
resize_method.Letterbox (Fit): Keep the whole image inside the target with padding.

guard_mode.burn_direction: Correct the learned latent burn direction only.
guard_mode.both: Correct positive and negative outlier signatures in this experimental guard.

seed_after_generate.fixed: Keep the independent refinement seed unchanged.
seed_after_generate.randomize: Choose another independent refinement seed after success.

canvas_mode.manual: Use the specified face crop canvas.
canvas_mode.auto_capped_768: Use the supported automatic face canvas with the 768-pixel cap.

select.largest_face: Choose the largest detected face as the target.
select.centre_most: Choose the detected face nearest the image centre.

paste_region.face_only: Blend the supported face-region mask back into the source.
paste_region.face_ellipse: Use an elliptical face-region replacement mask.
paste_region.full_crop: Replace/blend the whole processed crop, affecting more surrounding material.

seed_mode.inherit: Derive face processing from the clip seed without an added offset.
seed_mode.offset: Use the face-refinement offset seed policy.

ref_image_size.match: Forward the native match reference-image preparation policy for this graph group.
ref_image_size.1024: Request the native 1024 reference-image preparation policy.
ref_image_size.1280: Request the native 1280 reference-image preparation policy.
ref_image_size.1536: Request the native 1536 reference-image preparation policy.
ref_image_size.max: Forward the native max reference-image preparation policy for this graph group.

codec.Auto: Use the encoder's default H.264 mapping.
codec.H.264: Broadly compatible delivery video where supported.
codec.H.265: More efficient compression with narrower playback/encoder support.
codec.VP9: A WebM-oriented delivery codec where installed.
codec.AV1: Modern efficient compression; software encoding can be expensive.

container.mp4: Common delivery container; choose compatible video/audio codecs.
container.mkv: Matroska container with broad stream-format support.
container.webm: Web delivery container; use compatible VP9/AV1 and audio formats.
container.Animated WebP: Animated image output; do not expect a normal video soundtrack.
container.Animated AVIF: Animated image output requiring its encoder support; not a normal audiovisual movie.

encoder_backend.pyav: Encode through the installed Python/libav bindings.
encoder_backend.ffmpeg: Use the available FFmpeg executable and supported encoders.

bit_depth.Auto: Use the encoder's supported default pixel precision.
bit_depth.10-bit: Higher pixel precision where the selected codec/backend supports it; verify playback compatibility.

log_level.Verbose: More detail for diagnosing encoding problems.

audio_codec.Auto: Choose audio encoding appropriate to the container.
audio_codec.opus: Efficient sound encoding commonly used with WebM/Matroska.
audio_codec.mp3: Lossy sound encoding, subject to container support.
audio_codec.flac: Lossless sound compression, subject to container support.

policy.replace: Replace the supported authored clip content with the reviewed proposal.
policy.append: Add the proposed clips after the existing authored sequence.

lifetime.unload_after_draft: Release local prompt-model weights after drafting to free memory for H3.
lifetime.keep_loaded: Retain weights for faster later drafts while continuing to occupy memory.

stream.final: Export the current final result for each chosen clip.
stream.first_pass: Export available current first-pass review stages.
stream.pre_refine: Export available current frames captured before refinement.
stream.refine_pass: Export the chosen current refinement pass number.
stream.original_source: Export available original source footage, using the live pool when required.

selection.all: Include all available intended clips in timeline order.
selection.clip_ids: Include only the supplied stable clip IDs, in timeline order.

playback_policy.resample: Preserve wall-clock duration by dropping/repeating pictures at the target FPS; this is not motion synthesis.
playback_policy.retime: Keep picture count, change playback speed, and resize audio duration so its pitch also changes.

corner.bottom_right: Place the watermark near the lower-right corner.
corner.bottom_left: Place it near the lower-left corner.
corner.top_right: Place it near the upper-right corner.
corner.top_left: Place it near the upper-left corner.

source.auto: Detect a supported project format and report the conversion.
source.current: Interpret this pack's supported current project format.
source.dasiwa: Convert supported DaSiWa authoring data; review unmapped differences.
source.aimixer: Convert supported AIMixer authoring data; review unmapped differences.
source.tritant: Convert supported Tritant/Extender authoring data; review restored assets and algorithm differences.

MiniMaxH3DirectorRefine.backend.global: Refine video while retaining the first-pass audio.
MiniMaxH3DirectorRefine.backend.sampler: Sample the joint audiovisual latent; audio can change as well as video.

MiniMaxH3PromptForge.backend.local: Use the connected Local Prompt Model pipeline.
MiniMaxH3PromptForge.backend.compatible: Call the intended compatible language-model API endpoint.

MiniMaxH3LocalPromptModel.backend.transformers: Load a supported local Transformers model.
MiniMaxH3LocalPromptModel.backend.gguf: Load a supported local GGUF model, with matching vision projection when needed.

MiniMaxH3FrameInterpolation.provider.Linear: Blend between adjacent frames; lightweight but can ghost, and is not optical flow.
MiniMaxH3FrameInterpolation.provider.RTX: Use the supported NVIDIA frame-generation runtime and hardware.

MiniMaxH3PixelUpscale.provider.bicubic: Ordinary smooth pixel resize without learned enhancement.
MiniMaxH3PixelUpscale.provider.learned_pixel: Run the connected learned image upscale model, then fit the target size.
MiniMaxH3PixelUpscale.provider.RTX VSR: Use supported NVIDIA video super resolution; SDK/runtime required.
MiniMaxH3PixelUpscale.provider.RTX High Bitrate: Use the supported NVIDIA high-bitrate enhancement route; SDK/runtime required.

MiniMaxH3Cache.device.auto: Use the cache's automatic supported storage policy.
MiniMaxH3Cache.device.cuda: Keep cached residual data in GPU memory; saves transfers but occupies VRAM.
MiniMaxH3Cache.device.cpu: Store cached residual data on CPU; frees VRAM at a transfer cost.

MiniMaxH3LocalPromptModel.device.cpu: Run supported local prompt inference on the CPU; lower GPU use, often slower.
MiniMaxH3LocalPromptModel.device.cuda: Run supported local prompt inference on the GPU; competes with H3 for memory.
